purpose: Independent follow-on feasibility validation of the V3 non-overlapping packet-arrival observation in isolated software networking. It is not a deployment, attack, health, receiver-selection, or recovery study.
development_exclusion: All V1, V2, and V3 captures, including their 20 final V3 runs, are excluded from V4 performance estimation and parameter selection.

condition_parameters.benign_delay_jitter_no_loss: delay 100us 20us distribution normal, no configured loss

execution_constraints: Each run records seed/configuration, UTC and monotonic phase times, packet capture, process logs, qdisc evidence, and source manifest.
Conditions must be implemented in an isolated disposable namespace only and validated by a capability preflight.
If a condition cannot be executed exactly as frozen, preserve the failed attempt and report it; do not substitute another condition.

analysis.no_retuning: No threshold, condition, or inclusion change after the first V4 capture without superseding this protocol.

decision_boundary: V4 can only determine whether this packet-arrival observation repeats under its frozen software conditions. It cannot authorize a recovery loop, establish physical clock recovery, or prove detector generalization on its own.
